page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance built on the x86_64 architecture and virtualized via KVM. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor, it supplies 104 dedicated vCPUs running at a clock frequency of 2.5 GHz. The server includes 192.0 GB of memory, translating to a resource density of 1.85 GB RAM per vCPU core. Network performance is sustained by a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The architecture includes no local disk storage and no GPU hardware accelerators.

The instance prioritizes processing capacity over per-core memory capacity. The high dedicated core count offers cost efficiency for compute-heavy parallel workloads by maximizing vCPU density without incurring the overhead of unused memory. Major trade-offs involve complete reliance on network-attached storage for persistent operational data and the absence of GPU acceleration for artificial intelligence or specialized graphics tasks.

Workload fits for this hardware profile include parallel multi-threaded computing, batch processing, automated software compilation pipelines, financial modeling, and distributed application node deployments.

Recommended workload fits include compute-intensive batch processing, financial simulations, continuous integration build nodes, and scalable web application backends.
